# SI045 — verdict-overwritten-on-appeal

Appeals append a round; they never overwrite history.

## Why

The prior verdict is evidence. It must remain reconstructable after an appeal.

## Bad

```python
def appeal(...):
    self.verdicts[id] = new_verdict
```

## Good

```python
self.verdict_history[id].append(prior)
self.verdicts[id] = new_verdict
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI045 -- reason
```
